Features and within-participant repeatability

The matched pilot audits sample-wise amplitudes, 100 ms means and channel sets. Central channels showed promising descriptive separation; decoder comparisons were needed to select a feature design. Repeatability varied by session and run.

Scope and interpretation

This report displays saved numerical results and condition means. It does not rerun preprocessing, alter trial selection or fit a classifier. Displayed waveform values are rounded to five decimal places in µV. Raw recordings, individual trials and fitted models are excluded.
